personas.name: routine-orthopaedic-complete
personas.description: Routine knee-OA referral with every mandatory field, consent, and safety-netting present — expect Complete at 100%.

clinical.reasonForReferral: Progressive right knee osteoarthritis limiting walking distance despite conservative management
clinical.relevantHistory: Hypertension; BMI 31; physiotherapy completed twice with limited benefit

examination.examinationFindings: Varus deformity, crepitus, flexion limited to 100 degrees
examination.investigationResults: Weight-bearing X-ray: Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 medial compartment OA

expectations.safetyNetting: Advised to return if locking, giving way, or rest pain develops

personas.name: two-week-wait-colorectal
personas.description: NG12-criteria lower-GI two-week-wait referral: the three urgency-conditional mandatory fields (urgency reason, cancer criterion, pathway) are all present — expect Complete with the suspected-cancer pathway flag.

urgencyInfo.urgencyReason: NICE NG12 criteria met: change in bowel habit with rectal bleeding aged over 50
urgencyInfo.suspectedCancerCriterion: Aged >= 50 with rectal bleeding and change in bowel habit for 6 weeks

clinical.reasonForReferral: Six weeks of altered bowel habit with intermittent fresh rectal bleeding
clinical.relevantHistory: No prior colonoscopy; ferritin low at 18
clinical.presentingProblem: Change in bowel habit, PR bleeding, fatigue
clinical.redFlagSymptoms: Rectal bleeding, iron-deficiency anaemia, weight loss 3 kg

examination.examinationFindings: Abdomen soft; PR: no mass palpable, altered blood on glove

expectations.patientExpectations: Aware of two-week-wait reason and expects hospital contact
expectations.safetyNetting: Advised to attend ED if heavy bleeding or obstruction symptoms

flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Name the NICE NG12 criterion and the tumour-site pathway, and book on the two-week-wait pathway so the patient is seen within two weeks.
